translations.translatedText: # Monday 10.2.2020 (radio)
The paper industry strike is ending. The coronavirus is still spreading in China. There are now many locusts in Africa. Actor Juha Muje has died.
## The strike ended at paper mills
![Two men remove a Paper Workers' Union strike sign from the gate of UPM's Kymi paper mill in Kouvola.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11201862)
Open image viewer
The strike sign was taken down from the gate of the paper mill in Kouvola on Monday. Photo: Vesa Grekula / Yle
The paper industry strike is ending. Workers return to work on Monday evening, when the night shift starts. Many paper and pulp mills are starting up again.
Paper industry workers went on strike at the end of January. They then stopped work at many mills. The mills have been closed until now.
The paper industry strike is ending because the employee and employer organisations have approved a new collective agreement. The collective agreement decides, for example, wages and working hours.

It is important for the workers that the new collective agreement no longer has kiky hours. The kiky, or competitiveness, hours were agreed in 2016. They lengthened working time by 24 hours a year, but they did not bring any extra pay.
The paper industry employers are happy, because the new agreement shortens the midsummer break at the mills. The mills' midsummer break is shortened by 24 hours.
## The coronavirus is spreading in China
![A coronavirus patient is moved inside a hospital in Wuhan, China, on 4 February 2020.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11199308)
Open image viewer
A coronavirus patient in Wuhan, China. Photo: AOP
The coronavirus is still spreading in China. The coronavirus has killed about 1,000 people in China.
Over 40,000 Chinese people have caught the coronavirus. Most of them live in Hubei province.
The coronavirus was discovered in Hubei province in December. The centre of the cases is the city of Wuhan.
## Locusts threaten Africa
![Locusts](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11196736)
Open image viewer
Locusts eat the plants that are needed as food for people. Photo: Fredrik Lerneryd
There are now many locusts in Africa. Locusts are harmful, because they eat plants from fields. That is why people may run out of food.
In Kenya, for example, there have not been as many locusts for 70 years as there are now. The locusts are large, as long as a human finger.
There are many locusts because of heavy rains. In Kenya the rainy season is unusually long. Normally the rains end in November, but now they continue into February.
The number of locusts even threatens to grow. Already now there can be 150 million locusts in one square kilometre.
Soon the locusts will start breeding and having offspring. That is why in Kenya there may be 400 times more locusts in the summer than there are now.
## Juha Muje has died
![Juha Muje](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11201332)
Open image viewer
Actor Juha Muje. Photo: Mikko Stig / Lehtikuva
Actor Juha Muje has died. The Finnish National Theatre announced the matter on Monday.
Muje acted at the National Theatre, in films and in TV series. He was 69 years old.
